nodes.author: blinkkX1
nodes.text:
🧵 (1/2) The two cases of #HMPV were detected through India's routine surveillance system set up by ICMR. HMPV is a virus that has been in circulation in India for a long time. 

Also, currently there are also no unusual surge in respiratory diseases reported in the country. https://t.co/bl5OLV0s9e

nodes.author: blinkkX1
nodes.text:
🧵 (2/2) Will the world go into yet another pandemic? 

Unlike the COVID-19 virus, most of the people have immunity against HMPV and it is unlikely to trigger a Pandemic in its current form. 

Yet, it's important for everyone to take preventive measures including good hygiene. https://t.co/5f09MfSCUZ
